name: Trip search
summary: Where, when and who for a trip: a stays or flights switch, a destination field with suggestions, a two-month date range, and steppers for adults, children and pets.
use: at the top of a travel app or booking site, for starting a search for a stay or a flight
a11y: The destination is a combobox with a listbox (arrows move, Enter picks, Escape closes); each day is a button named with its full date and aria-pressed on check-in and check-out, the range summary is a live region, and stepper buttons disable at their limits.

use_when: any booking that needs a place, a date range and a head count in one form, such as a holiday rental or a hotel
avoid_when: showing flights already found: use flight-results
picking only a date range inside a work tool: use date-range-picker
narrowing a list of results that is already on screen: use filter-bar

parts.name: mode
parts.what: a two-way switch: Stays or Flights

parts.name: where_label
parts.what: the destination question; reads Flying to in Flights

parts.name: suggestions
parts.what: one suggestion: a photo, the place with the typed part marked, and its kind and count

parts.name: range
parts.what: the chosen dates and number of nights, announced as it changes

parts.name: months
parts.what: one month: its name, weekday letters and a grid of day buttons

parts.name: days
parts.what: one day; check-in and check-out are filled, the nights between are banded

parts.name: guests
parts.what: one guest kind with a hint and a minus, count, plus stepper; Pets hides in Flights

parts.name: steppers
parts.what: fewer and more buttons, disabled at their limits

parts.name: search
parts.what: the submit button, which repeats the guest count

empty.how: when nothing matches the typed text the suggestions list closes; there is no 'No matches' line

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if search fails or no place was picked, mark the field invalid with a message under it, or put an alert-banners line above Search

disabled.how: steppers disable at their limits (one adult, zero children or pets, ten of each) in the disabled colours

overflow.how: the suggestions list grows with every match; cap it at five rows or give it its own max height with overflow-y: auto

long_text.how: suggestion text wraps in a column beside the photo, and the When line wraps under its heading
long_text.evidence: .odl-trip-search .odl-sugg li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches the Stays and Flights switch as one radio group; the arrow keys change it
In the destination field, typing filters the suggestions, Down and Up arrows move through them, Enter picks the highlighted one and Escape closes the list
Tab reaches every day button; Enter or Space on the first sets check-in and on a later day sets check-out
Tab then reaches each Fewer and More button and Search; Enter or Space presses them
